entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: A large genetic engineering project set up by Urza to create perfect warriors to fight the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who set up the project, seeking an army and an heir worthy of the Legacy.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Led researchers at the Tolarian Academy and contested Urza's methods.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Chancellor of the Tolarian Academy, appointed by Urza partly to produce an offspring with Barrin.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: A scientist who spliced Phyrexian DNA into test subjects and continued his project in Keld.

entities.name: Kreig
entities.description: The fiercest of Gatha's Keldon warlords, considered the most powerful Keldon ever, who seized power in Keld.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: A Phyrexian sent to investigate Keld and retrieve research, who started a war with Keld.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The legitimate heir to the Legacy and end product of the project, who sacrificed his life to activate the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, the only known human survivor of the first phase.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Daughter of Rayne and Barrin, the last known individual born of the Project.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: A twin Metathran commander with superior intellect and free will, telepathically bonded with Agnate.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: A twin Metathran commander, bonded with Thaddeus.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure who safely transported Gerrard Capashen to Jamuura.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The enemy defeated when the Legacy Weapon was activated.

entities.name: Rha'ud
entities.description: An early, misshapen result of the project.

entities.name: Trohg
entities.description: Ancestor of Kreig.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: An artificially created magical race of soldiers engineered in the project's second phase, who died out after the war.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The academy whose full resources were mobilized for the project.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who launched a preemptive strike on the Bloodline project sites.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: A Benalian lineage Urza interfered with directly.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance in whose battles the Metathran took part.

entities.name: Weatherlight Crew
entities.description: The crew who aided Gerrard in activating the Legacy Weapon.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: The nation where Gatha continued his experiments, producing Keldon hybrids.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where Urza discovered the Invasion of Tolaria.

entities.name: Legacy Weapon
entities.description: The weapon Gerrard sacrificed his life to activate to defeat Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion the project was designed to defeat.

events.summary: In 3347, back at Tolaria after the Invasion of Tolaria began, Urza realizes he needs an army and an heir and starts arranging eugenics matches.
events.quote: he started selecting researchers and scholars with particular skill sets within eugenics and started arranging mating matches

events.summary: The academy manipulates marriages between families strong in white mana, including the Capashen and Sisay's ancestors.
events.quote: the academy soon had almost complete control over who wedded whom

events.summary: Urza appoints Rayne chancellor to push her and Barrin into producing an offspring.
events.quote: Urza also appointed Rayne as the chancellor of the Tolarian academy

events.summary: Urza creates the Metathran army in the second phase amid controversy; Barrin contests his methods and some researchers quit.
events.quote: Barrin started openly contesting Urza's methods

events.summary: Gatha experiments with splicing Phyrexian DNA into test subjects and is expelled, continuing in Keld.
events.quote: While he was found out and expelled, he continued his project in Keld .

events.summary: Kreig seizes power in Keld with Gatha at his side; Croag starts a war to retrieve the research, and Gatha and Kreig jump off a cliff to keep their knowledge from Phyrexia.
events.quote: Gatha and Kreig jumped off a cliff to keep their knowledge and genetic potential out of Phyrexia's reach

events.summary: The Phyrexians launch a preemptive strike on project sites, killing thousands including Sisay's parents; Gerrard survives, carried to Jamuura by Karn.
events.quote: launched a preemptive strike against sites where the Bloodline project was taking place, killing thousands of people

events.summary: Hanna is born in 4181, the last known individual born of the project.
events.quote: The last known individual to be born of the Project was Hanna

events.summary: The Metathran army, awoken under Thaddeus and Agnate, helps win the battles of Koilos and the Stronghold.
events.quote: winning both the battle of Koilos in Terisiare and the battle of the Stronghold in Urborg

events.summary: Aided by the Weatherlight crew, Gerrard sacrifices his life to activate the Legacy Weapon, defeating Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Gerrard Capashen sacrificed his life to activate the Legacy Weapon

events.summary: The Metathran race dies out with the war, being engineered to fight and incapable of reproducing.
events.quote: the Metathran race died out with the war they were born to fight
